text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to create the release branch for v2.8.0 tomorrow 2026-03-18 18:00 PT. Need owners for backports, a changelog lead, and a short preflight. Anyone oncall or blocked that window?
jamie: I can own the changelog and release notes. Will gather PR one-liners today. Please add the PR link and a single-sentence summary.
alex: thanks @jamie. branch name will be `release/v2.8.0`. Cutting from `origin/main`.
robin: QA can do a smoke pass right after branch creation — I can take the 18:00–19:00 PT slot. No special matrix unless someone flags a flaky test.
maria: I’ll triage backport requests. Quick reminder on rules: backports only for bugfixes and infra regressions since rc1; security fixes always ok. Tag PRs with `backport-needed` and add the target branch in the PR body.
jamie: small checklist for authors: add changelog entry under `changelogs/unreleased/`, add `backport-needed` label if applicable, and reference the release issue like `#4567`.
alex: pinging @maria — for cherry-picks, do we prefer creating a dedicated backport PR per commit or squashed?
maria: prefer one commit per backport PR so we can trace easily. Include the original commit hash and a short rationale. Use the template: `Backport-of: <sha>` in the description.
jamie: command I'll run to cut branch:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/v2.8.0 origin/main
# push and open release PR
git push origin release/v2.8.0
```
ci-bot: Heads-up: branch protection requires 2 approvals + green CI before merging into `release/*`. If you need a temporary exception, file a release-exception ticket.
alex: timeline: I’ll create the branch at 18:00 PT, open the release PR, and tag @jamie for changelog review. Authors: please have changelog drafts by 15:00 PT so we can assemble.
robin: quick question — should hotfixes that landed on main after the cut be queued for immediate backport or wait for next minor?
maria: if they’re critical (regression/security) we pick them into release/v2.8.0; otherwise queue for v2.9.0. I’ll maintain a short list in the release issue.
jamie: noted. I added a small checklist to the release issue: summary, changelog owner, backport owner, QA slot, rollback plan. Link: https://go/release-issue/v2.8.0 (internal).
alex: final ask — if you plan to request a backport, drop the PR link in this thread + label. I’ll do a quick owners sweep at 16:30 PT to confirm reviewers.
robin: :thumbsup: I’ll be available for the smoke.
maria: will start triaging now, marking candidates with `needs-backport-review`.
ci-bot: Reminder: run `./scripts/release-preflight.sh` before branch cut to validate manifest versions and changelog presence.
alex: thanks all — see you at the cut. If anything blocks, DM me ASAP.
robin: ACK, thanks for organizing.
